codex.habitat: Unlit space below 155 m. It has never been recorded nearer the surface.
codex.behaviour: Approaches without hurrying. Dissolves out of view when hurt, and reappears elsewhere.
codex.diet: No feeding behaviour has been observed. It does not appear to need any.
codex.resource: Worked stone, in fragments. It was carrying them.
codex.weakness: Sustained light holds it at a distance, but does not stop it.
codex.lore: Its limbs do not join to its body in a way that could have grown. It is carrying masonry. It is the first thing down here that looks assembled rather than born.

variants.note: More eyes. All of them open.
